subject: math

items.prompt:
A soup can is best modeled as a:
A) Sphere
B) Cylinder
C) Cone
D) Cube

A basketball is best modeled as a:
A) Cylinder
B) Cone
C) Sphere
D) Prism

A shipping box is best modeled as a:
A) Cylinder
B) Rectangular prism
C) Sphere
D) Cone

Which formula estimates a can's capacity?
A) $\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3$
B) $\pi r^2 h$
C) $lwh$
D) $\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h$

An ice-cream cone is modeled as a:
A) Cylinder
B) Cone
C) Sphere
D) Cube

steps: Round top tapering to a point.

items.prompt:
A can of radius $3$ and height $10$ has capacity (in terms of $\pi$):
A) $30\pi$
B) $90\pi$
C) $60\pi$
D) $9\pi$

A beach ball of radius $3$ has volume (in terms of $\pi$):
A) $9\pi$
B) $27\pi$
C) $36\pi$
D) $12\pi$

Why model a real object with a geometric solid?
A) To change its shape
B) To estimate size, capacity, or material using formulas
C) To make it heavier
D) There is no reason
items.answer: B) To estimate size, capacity, or material using formulas

steps: Models let us apply formulas to estimate.
